title: Avoid Harmful Social Behaviors
summary: The Hadith advises against harmful social actions such as suspicion, spying, and envy, promoting brotherhood and unity instead.
translation: In this Hadith, the Holy Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) forbade actions that corrupt society and harm both individual and collective life. Hazrat Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him) narrates that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said, "Avoid suspicion because suspicion is the worst of lies." Similarly, the Prophet (peace be upon him) instructed not to unnecessarily pry into others' affairs or spy on each other. He further said, "Do not undermine each other’s transactions or dealings." He also instructed not to harbor envy, hatred, or backbite each other. Moreover, the Prophet (peace be upon him) said, "Be like brothers as servants of Allah." In another narration, the words "Do not covet each other; do not be greedy towards each other" are included. Avoiding these actions can protect against many societal ills, and society can remain free from these negative behaviors. Therefore, it is necessary to act upon the Prophet's guidance and feel personally responsible for abandoning such sins. We should pray to Allah, the Exalted, to make it easy to abandon these sins.
